policies.name: Agent Deal Access
policies.rule: Agents may only access deals within their assigned scope.

policies.name: Restricted Securities
policies.rule: Trading restricted securities requires compliance review.

policies.name: Agent Communication Access
policies.rule: Personal agents may only search communications belonging to their owner unless explicitly authorized.

policies.name: Deal Valuation Change Policy
policies.rule: Changes greater than 20% require Managing Director approval.

policies.name: Firm Compliance Agent
policies.rule: The Firm Compliance Agent has firm-wide read access but cannot modify deal or trading records.

policies.name: High-Risk Agent Action
policies.rule: AI-initiated financial changes above $10M require human approval.

policies.name: Deal Valuation Change Policy
policies.description: Material changes to deal valuations require senior approval.
